name: devmate-kit
description: Your daily work radar: GitHub pull requests and Jira tickets that need your attention, right inside VS Code — with optional AI summaries and handy text utilities.

enumDescriptions: Use language models available in this editor through the VS Code Language Model API (GitHub Copilot, Claude via Copilot or another provider, …).
Use the Cursor Agent CLI on your PATH (`agent` / `cursor-agent`) in ask/print-only mode. Real subprocess backend — not a fake editor model.
Deprecated: same as vscodeLm. Kept so existing settings keep working.
devMateKit.ai.provider.markdownDescription: AI runtime for DevMate Kit. `vscodeLm` uses host chat models via the Language Model API; `cursorCli` spawns the Cursor Agent CLI (ask/print only). DevMate never stores Anthropic/OpenAI API keys.

devMateKit.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model id. For `vscodeLm`, leave empty to use the first GitHub Copilot model (or the first available). For `cursorCli`, mapped to the CLI `--model` flag when non-empty. Pick from the live list with **DevMate Kit: Select AI Model**.

devMateKit.ai.reviewPrompt.default:
Review PR #{number} in {repo}: {title}
{url}

## How to work this request
You are an editor coding agent with workspace access and (when available) GitHub/Jira MCP tools.
DevMate only supplied a short triage snapshot. Do not invent a PR diff, check log, or Jira description from that snapshot.

### Always do this first
1. Identify GitHub targets (PR URL or owner/repo#number) and Jira targets (browse URL or issue key like WEB-123).
2. Fetch live data with MCP (or equivalent tools) before answering.
3. If a needed tool is missing or fails, say which one and what to enable — do not fabricate the missing content.

### GitHub (when a PR is in scope)
Use GitHub MCP / PR tools to load as needed: PR metadata and description, file diffs, check runs, reviews, and comments.
Base review, summary, failing-check analysis, or draft replies on that live data.

### Jira (when a ticket is in scope)
Use Jira MCP / issue tools to load as needed: description, status, assignee, due date, comments, linked issues/PRs.
If a linked PR is present and the answer depends on code, also fetch that PR from GitHub.

### If this prompt includes "Conversation so far"
Treat it as prior DevMate Ask AI triage. Continue from the latest user goal, but prefer live MCP facts over snapshot guesses in that transcript.

### Output
Be concrete and actionable. Separate facts (from tools) from recommendations. Keep comment drafts short enough to paste.

### This task
Start by fetching this PR (diff + checks + comments), then review for correctness, risky changes, and missing tests.
Status: {status}
devMateKit.ai.reviewPrompt.markdownDescription: Prompt template for **Continue in editor chat** (clipboard hand-off). Placeholders: `{number}`, `{repo}`, `{title}`, `{url}`, `{status}`. Keep portable MCP how-to in the template so paste works in Copilot, Cursor, and other editor chats — not sent to the in-dashboard AI.

devMateKit.github.monitoredAuthors.description: GitHub usernames whose pull requests are tracked as Team PRs.

devMateKit.jira.siteUrl.description: Jira Cloud site URL, e.g. https://yoursite.atlassian.net.

devMateKit.jira.siteId.description: Internal: the Jira site's Atlassian cloud ID, set automatically after connecting.

devMateKit.jira.currentUser.description: Your Jira display name, exactly as it appears on your issues (e.g. the "assignee" name). Used to filter "My Jira Tasks" on the Daily Tasks dashboard.

devMateKit.jira.teamMembers.description: Jira display names of teammates to include in team task monitoring.

devMateKit.jira.savedQueries.description: Saved JQL queries used to fetch Jira tasks.

devMateKit.jira.noPrStatuses.description: Jira statuses that count as in-progress for the "no open PR" Attention Inbox flag (case-insensitive).

devMateKit.jira.noPrDays.description: Days without Jira activity before flagging an in-progress ticket that has no open pull request.

devMateKit.attention.ignoreShortReplies.description: When true, a latest non-bot comment under about 15 characters does not count as "awaiting your reply" in the Attention Inbox.

devMateKit.monitoring.enabled.description: Keep watching GitHub and Jira. Turn off to pause all monitoring network activity (no refresh, no connections) while keeping your sign-in.

devMateKit.notifications.enabled.description: Show a notification when a background refresh finds new items that need your attention.

devMateKit.refresh.background.description: Keep refreshing GitHub and Jira every 10 minutes even when no DevMate view is open (powers the status bar count and notifications).

devMateKit.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the attention count in the status bar.
